provider: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin
attribution: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin – Stadtentwicklungsplan (StEP) Zentren 2040 (WFS step_zen_2040), Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero – Version 2.0; reprojected to EPSG:4326

limitations: StEP Zentren 2040 (dataset reference date 2026-01-13) is a planning designation of Berlin's retail-center hierarchy by SenSBW; it does not measure footfall, sales, revenue, rents, vacancy, or shop counts.

Boundaries are published only for the two Zentrumsbereich polygons (zh layer); all other centers and all Fachmarkt sites are representative points. No boundary is inferred; membership can only be tested for published polygons.
Parcel-exact boundaries of zentrale Versorgungsbereiche and Nahversorgungszentren are set in district center concepts and are not part of this WFS.
Fachmarkt sites (fma layer) are planning sites for large specialist stores with non-center-relevant assortments (furniture, DIY, garden); they are not städtische Zentren.

Proximity to a center is commercial context only; it is not measured footfall, revenue, or a guarantee of location suitability. Distances are straight-line metres in EPSG:25833, not walking distance or time.
